tldr: Venus through the 3rd house softens messages, conversations, learning, and daily movement.
body:
When Venus moves through your 3rd house, it draws your attention toward messages, conversations, errands, siblings, neighbors, learning, planning, and what needs to be said. You may notice more activity in your immediate world: conversations to have, details to track, short trips to make, or a decision that needs clearer words.

You may notice what feels wanted, valuable, pleasurable, attractive, or worth protecting. It can help you see what you actually want to choose, keep, enjoy, or repair.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for naming the thing that has been circling in your mind.

The caution: Watch for choosing the pleasant answer because the honest one would ask more of you. The risk is getting scattered by every message, detail, or possible interpretation.

Venus moves through this house for a few weeks. Let ease show you what you value. Just do not confuse comfort with truth.
